cases.name: Loan and return
cases.prompt: I loaned my navy tote, identifier T2, to a friend through May 20. Its usual place is upper shelf. My other navy tote is T1.
expectations: Assigns the loan only to T2.
Retains upper shelf as T2's normal storage.
Records the May 20 agreed return date.

cases.name: Occasion selection
cases.prompt: Need a hands-free bag for a concert with a 6 by 9 inch limit. My crossbody is 5 by 8, clutch is 4 by 7 with no strap, and the 5 by 8 belt bag is loaned out.
expectations: Explains that the clutch lacks the hands-free feature.
Excludes the loaned belt bag from available options.

cases.name: Tentative photo identification
cases.prompt: I saw a designer-looking bag online. Add it to my wishlist. The picture is unavailable and no price is given.
expectations: Records it as a wishlist candidate.
Leaves maker, authenticity and price unknown.
Requests identifying text or observable features if more detail is wanted.
